pages.text: The Range Upgrade increases the wireless range of wireless devices. Each upgrade installed will extend the range by a certain amount.
Features:$(li)Increases wireless range$(li)Can be stacked for greater effect$(li)Works in Wireless Transmitters$(li)Increases power consumption
To use the Range Upgrade:$(li)Right-click on a Wireless Transmitter$(li)Insert the upgrade into an upgrade slot$(li)Multiple upgrades can be installed$(li)Each upgrade will increase power consumption
